title: The Rich man and Lazarus
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child describes Luke 16:19-31: a rich man feasts daily while Lazarus lies hungry at his gate, both die, Lazarus is comforted at Abraham's side, the rich man is in torment, a great chasm lies between, and Abraham says the brothers have Moses and the Prophets; lessons: care for the poor, listen to God's word now.

floor.question: Why did the rich young man go away sad?

representations: a gate with a beggar drawn
two sides with a chasm between
steps: A rich man and a beggar at his gate.
Comfort and torment, a chasm between.
The brothers have Moses and the Prophets.
contexts: a beggar at the shopping centre

board.do: Draw a big house, a gate, and a man lying at the gate.
Point at the man at the gate.
board.say: What was the rich man's wrong?

board.do: Wait for the child to say he ignored Lazarus.

misconceptions.ask: Why was the rich man in torment (Luke 16:19-25)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 16:19-21: Lazarus lay at his gate daily, hungry. The sin was ignoring him.

listen_for: The brother of Mary and Martha
misconceptions.ask: Which Lazarus lay at the rich man's gate?
misconceptions.repair: Make two cards: Lazarus of Bethany (John 11, real man raised); Lazarus the beggar (Luke 16, a parable).

misconceptions.ask: What lay between the rich man and Lazarus (Luke 16:26)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 16:26: a great chasm. Ask what it means that no one could cross.

misconceptions.ask: What did Abraham answer when asked to send Lazarus to the five brothers (Luke 16:29)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 16:29-31: the brothers already had God's word. The lesson: listen now.

checks.question: Why was the rich man in torment?
checks.answer: He ignored the beggar at his gate

checks.question: Is this Lazarus the brother of Mary and Martha?
checks.answer: No: a beggar in a parable
